standard.summary: SPD 是多分辨率推理路线：从低分辨率 latent 逐级推进到目标分辨率。当前是 default-off schedule/resize primitive。
standard.effect: 不同阶段使用不同 latent 尺寸和 step 预算，理论上能降低部分计算或改善大图稳定性。
standard.whenToUse: 后续做高分辨率 Anima/Newbie 推理 A/B 或 trajectory LoRA 研究时。
standard.avoidWhen: 当前需要可直接开启的 sampler；真实 denoise-loop 集成还未完成。

standard_en.summary: SPD is a multi-resolution inference route: it advances the latent stage by stage from a low resolution up to the target resolution. Today it is a default-off schedule/resize primitive.
standard_en.effect: Each stage uses a different latent size and step budget, which in theory can cut some computation or improve stability on large images.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you later run high-resolution Anima/Newbie inference A/Bs or trajectory LoRA research.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need a sampler you can switch on directly; the real denoise-loop integration is not finished yet.

advanced.principle: 构建多级 latent schedule，在阶段边界 resize latent 并记录 metadata。
advanced.intervention: Future sampler loop → latent resize schedule → optional trajectory LoRA。
advanced.expectedImpact: 完整接入后可能降低大图推理成本；当前不改变运行时行为。
advanced.tradeoffs: trajectory LoRA 被阻断到 SPD route 和 metadata 稳定之后。

advanced_en.principle: Builds a multi-level latent schedule, resizing latents at stage boundaries and recording metadata.
advanced_en.intervention: Future sampler loop → latent resize schedule → optional trajectory LoRA.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Once fully wired in, may reduce large-image inference cost; currently does not change runtime behavior.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The trajectory LoRA is blocked until the SPD route and metadata stabilize.
